params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $repo='C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridgeRepo'; $wt='C:\Users\Xxkan\hb-main-validate-1101'; if(Test-Path $wt){ git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null }; git -C $repo fetch origin '+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main'; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; git -C $repo worktree add --detach $wt refs/remotes/origin/main; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; try { Push-Location $wt; $sha=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); Write-Output "TESTING_MAIN=$sha"; if(-not (Test-Path 'heaven-bridge/worker.py')){ Write-Error 'worker.py missing from exact-main worktree'; exit 2 }; python -m py_compile 'heaven-bridge/worker.py' 'heaven-bridge/test_worker.py' 'heaven-bridge/tests/test_worker.py'; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; python 'heaven-bridge/test_worker.py' -q; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; python -m unittest discover -s 'heaven-bridge/tests' -v; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}; Write-Output "VALIDATED_MAIN=$sha"; } finally { Pop-Location -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null }
